title.de: Indirekte Steuern eines Haushalts (Schätzung ≈): Umsatzsteuer und Verbrauchsteuern nach Haushaltsnettoeinkommen
title.en: A household's indirect taxes (estimate ≈): VAT and excises by household net income class

basis: ESTIMATE*: LWR 2024 monthly consumption per household (Destatis, all household sizes) × statutory VAT rates per purpose × 12, plus excise shares for energy, fuel, tobacco, alcohol and insurance from price assumptions. Not a measurement; quality flags of the LWR cells not propagated.

method.vat: VAT inside the gross spend: spend × r/(1+r) with r from the table 'vat_rate_assumptions'; rent, health, education, finance, insurance exempt
method.excises: spend × assumed excise share (table 'excise_assumptions'); the shares depend on assumed prices
method.recipients: VAT by the effective 2024 split Bund 48.10 % / Länder 49.11 % / Gemeinden 2.79 % (data/de/equalisation/2024.json); energy, electricity, tobacco, spirits, sparkling-wine and insurance taxes to the Federation; beer tax to the Länder (Art. 106 GG)
method.wage_slider_mapping: The classes are HOUSEHOLD NET income per month (all household members). For a single earner, use the payslip net ÷ 12 to pick the class*; for couples add both nets.

caveats: Order-of-magnitude estimate: VAT rate assignment is per purpose group, not per product; excise shares rest on assumed retail prices.

Survey under-coverage: LWR/EVS households report far less tobacco and alcohol than market sales imply (tobacco tax receipts 15.6 bn ÷ 38.7 m households ≈ 400 EUR vs ≈ 90 EUR here; alcohol similar), so the excise lines are lower bounds.

Biggest levers: car purchases and fuel (19 % + energy tax), package holidays (set to 0 VAT here), restaurant meals (19 % in 2024, 7 % from 2026) and the treatment of items with mixed rates (soft drinks, air travel, streaming).
Insurance tax is not included (premiums are outside LWR consumption).
Household (not person) and net-income (not gross-wage) classes; richer households save more, so indirect taxes fall as a share of income.
Quality flags ('/', '()') of small cells are not propagated; the lowest class has few households.
